welcome.title: Yames
welcome.tagline: A guitar coach that listens. Choose a Path, and each day's Session fits the minutes you have.
welcome.taglineMobile: Guitar practice that listens. Choose a Path, and each day's Session fits the minutes you have.

soundLook.title: Sound & look
soundLook.subtitle: Hover a card to hear the click or see the theme. The theme dresses Today, the Paths and the neck.
soundLook.subtitleTouch: Tap a card to hear the click or try the theme. The theme dresses Today, the Paths and the neck.

handsFree.title: Hands stay on the instrument
handsFree.subtitle: In a Session these keys already work. One footswitch can run a Session too, and it still plays and stops the tools.

keyboard.hint: Every key is remappable in Settings → Hotkeys.

midi.title: MIDI footswitch
midi.none: Plug one in any time — Yames will offer to map it.
midi.listening: Press the pedal you want to use.

gamepad.title: Gamepad
gamepad.none: Connect a controller any time — press a button and Yames will see it.
gamepad.listening: Press the button you want to use as the pedal.

session.title: In a Session
session.go: Start or end the Take, or press the big button
session.watch: Watch the notes light up in order on the {{neck}}, before a Take

pedal.title: One footswitch
pedal.tools: Outside a Session, a tap plays and stops the tools.

coach.title: Practice coach
coach.what1: The coach reads your Takes and your Paths: it gives you Today's line, a note after a Take, and answers when you ask.
coach.question: Should the coach also answer in its own words?
coach.withoutModel: Off still gives you the line, the note, the tools and answers from your Takes and Paths.
coach.privacy: Everything runs on this machine. Your audio never leaves it, and release builds never record it.

off.title: Off
off.desc: No download. The coach answers from your Takes and Paths.

standard.title: Standard model
standard.desc: Qwen3 4B · ~2.5 GB download · ~4 GB RAM while running. Runs on the CPU if you have no GPU.

studio.title: Studio model
studio.desc: Qwen3 8B · ~5 GB download · ~8 GB RAM. Richer feedback and practice plans.

coach.studioNeedsRam: Studio needs at least 16 GB of RAM — this machine has {{gb}} GB.
coach.standardNeedsRam: The Standard model needs at least 8 GB of RAM — this machine has {{gb}} GB.
coach.reasonNoLlm: This build can't run a model, so Off is the honest choice here.
coach.reasonLowMemory: This machine has {{gb}} GB of RAM — not enough to run a coach model comfortably.
coach.reasonInstalled: Already downloaded on this machine — nothing to fetch.
coach.downloadNote: The download starts when you continue and keeps running in the background.

audioInput.title: How will I hear you?
audioInput.subtitle: Pick how your guitar reaches the computer, then play a few notes. The meter shows what Yames hears.

mic.title: Microphone
mic.desc: Your guitar in the room, through the computer's mic or a USB mic. Single notes work best.

direct.title: Direct input
direct.desc: A cable from the guitar into an audio interface. The cleanest signal.

audioInput.noInterface: No audio interface found. Plug it in and it appears in the list below, or use the microphone.

guidance.electric-guitar: Plug into an interface, or play in front of the laptop mic — the mic works, an interface is better.
guidance.acoustic-guitar: Play towards the laptop mic, or use a pickup through an interface. Both work.
guidance.bass: An interface is best for bass — laptop mics lose the low end, though they still hear the attack.
guidance.drums: Any mic in the room will do. Put it where it hears the whole kit, not one drum.
guidance.piano: A mic near the instrument is enough. A digital piano can go straight into an interface.
guidance.other: An interface is better, but the laptop mic works — just play close to it.

audioInput.waiting: Play something — the meter needs a second of signal.
audioInput.heard: Got it. Yames can hear you.
audioInput.skip: Skip, I'll set this up later

noDevices.title: No input found
noDevices.body: Plug in a microphone or an audio interface; the list updates by itself. On a laptop, check that the built-in mic is not switched off.

openFailed.title: This input would not open
openFailed.body: Another app may be using it, or Yames may not be allowed to use the microphone. Close the other app or allow access, then try again.

silent.title: Nothing heard yet
silent.mic: Play closer to the microphone, and a little louder.
silent.direct: Turn up the guitar's volume knob and the interface's gain, and pick the input channel your cable is plugged into.
silent.permission: Microphone access: on macOS, System Settings › Privacy & Security › Microphone, turn Yames on; on Windows, Settings › Privacy › Microphone, allow desktop apps. Then restart Yames.
silent.other: Still nothing? Try another device in the list, or skip: the tools work without an input.

phone.subtitle: Pick how your guitar reaches the phone, then play a few notes. The meter shows what Yames hears.
phone.micDesc: Your guitar in the room, through the phone's own mic. Single notes work best; hold the phone near the guitar.
phone.directDesc: A USB-C audio interface (iRig HD, Scarlett with an adapter, an amp with USB) or a headset-jack adapter like the iRig 2. The cleanest signal.
phone.guidance: An interface or a jack adapter is better, but the phone's mic works: put it close to the guitar, not in your pocket.
phone.noDevices: No input found. Plug in the interface or the adapter; if it still does not appear, unplug it and plug it in again.
phone.permission: Microphone access: Android Settings › Apps › Yames › Permissions › Microphone, then Allow. A USB interface or a jack adapter needs the same permission.

ask.title: Should Yames listen to your playing and grade it?
ask.subtitle: Either way you get your plan, the click and the visuals. You can change this in Settings any time.
ask.yesDesc: Yames listens through a mic or direct input and checks your timing and notes. Next, set it up.
ask.no: No, just the click and the visuals
ask.noDesc: Nothing listens and no microphone is asked for. Your minutes and streak still count.
ask.noNote: Sessions will play without grading. You can turn it on from any Session or in Settings.

hearItWork.title: Hear it work
hearItWork.subtitle: Four beats to get ready, then play along for eight. Nothing is invented — you see exactly what was heard.
hearItWork.ready: Play along with the click. One note on every beat is plenty.
hearItWork.nothing: Didn't hear anything — check the input level.

ready.title: You're ready
ready.subtitle: Your first Session is ready on Today. Change anything here, or later in Settings.
ready.notificationNote: The first time you press play, your phone will ask if Yames can show a notification — say yes and the click keeps going with the screen off.
ready.coachTiming: Off: answers from your Takes and Paths
ready.subtitleNext: Your next Session is ready on Today. Change anything here, or later in Settings.

drillFirstOpen.body: Set start, target and step. Adaptive mode lets the coach decide.

presetSuggest.body: You keep coming back to this setup. Save it as a preset?

coachAsk.body: Press ? any time to ask the coach about this.

zenFirst.body: Esc leaves Zen. Effects are in Settings → Appearance.

widgetDiscover.body: Try the floating widget (W) over your DAW or tabs.

midiPlugged.body: A MIDI device is connected but nothing is mapped. Map a pedal to Play/Stop?

jamSheets.body: Set up changes the band; Chords is your cheat sheet.

jamLive.body: Everything here changes at the next bar.

jamArrangement.body: The band builds and breaks down on its own — Loop in Set up turns that off.

tour.offer: New: a short tour of Today, Paths, a Session and Progress.

bpm.title: Tempo
bpm.body: Drag, scroll, type, or tap the tempo.

subdivision.title: Subdivisions & groups
subdivision.body: Click subdivisions and shape the bar with beat groups.

presets.title: Presets
presets.body: Save any setup and switch instantly.

drill.title: Drill
drill.body: Ramp tempo automatically; the coach can adapt it.

coach.title: Practice coach
coach.body: Ask it anything here. In the tools, turn on Listen in the bottom bar and it hears you play.

zenWidget.title: Zen & widget
zenWidget.body: Fullscreen visuals, or a tiny always-on-top widget.

plan.title: Today's plan
plan.body: Today builds a Session from your Paths to fit your minutes. Each row says what it is and why it is in. Press a row to start there, or Swap to trade it for another.

start.title: Your minutes, then Start
start.body: Pick how long you have, or one Path, and the plan refits. Start plays it from the top, and you can leave whenever you like.

paths.title: Paths
paths.body: Pick a goal here. Nothing is locked: open any Path and start at any Step.

neck.title: Read the neck
neck.body: The numbers are fingers: 1 is your index, 4 your little finger. Your first note is where it says “start here”.

watch.title: Watch it first
watch.body: Watch plays it once for you, with sound, after a bar of count-in, each note lit as it sounds: hear it and see it before you try it.

take.title: Start take
take.body: When you are ready, start a take. Yames listens and grades your timing and notes. Slower and Faster change the tempo.
take.bodyOff: When you are ready, start. Grading is off, so it's the click and the picture, nothing graded. Slower and Faster change the tempo.
take.bodyAsk: When you are ready, start a take: graded, with Yames listening, or just played. Your choice. Slower and Faster change the tempo.

blocks.title: Today's blocks
blocks.body: Each block of the Session is up here. Press one to go to it. ‹ Previous goes back one, Skip moves on.

progress.title: Clean tempo
progress.body: Progress counts clean tempo: the fastest you met the pass mark, not just the fastest you played. That is the number to grow.
progress.bodyOff: Progress keeps your minutes, your streak and the tempos you played. With grading on it adds your clean tempo.
progress.bodyAsk: Progress counts clean tempo: the fastest you met the pass mark, not just the fastest you played. That is the number to grow.

help.title: Help
help.sendFeedbackNote: Opens a GitHub issue in your browser with the version and system filled in. Nothing is sent until you submit it.
help.reportDone: Diagnostics saved. Attach this file to your report:
help.reportError: Could not write the diagnostics file.
help.alwaysOnTopNote: Yames stays above other windows. Change that in Settings → General.

start.title: Where do you start?
start.subtitle: Pick a Path and your Level. Today builds your first Session from there; change either on the Path page.
start.subtitleNext: Pick a Path and your Level. Today builds your next Session from there; change either on the Path page.
start.goalQuestion: What do you want most right now?

goals.basics: I'm new: the basics, in time

why.none: Where most players start: time, the click and clean notes.
why.basics: New to the guitar: time and clean notes, and your first chords, so it sounds like music from the first week.
why.harmony: Chords and keys start with the notes on the neck, then scales, triads, chords in a key and arpeggios over the changes.
why.technique: Even, clean picking is what every fast line is built on.
why.speed: Your technique is already solid, so you go straight to speed.

whatsNew.title: What's new in {{version}}
whatsNew.noNotes: You're on a new version. The full release notes are on the web.
